authority: ADR-0009 + infrastructure.md §5.2 (refusal #2 full enumerated allowlist, refusal #3 tip-account pinning)
description: The signer-side program-ID allowlist and the value-moving-transfer destination pin. aats-signer LOADS this at boot, runs the build-time / boot-time live-verification described below, and REFUSES to sign any transaction that (a) carries an instruction whose program_id is not in `allowed_programs`, or (b) carries a System-program SOL transfer whose recipient is not in `value_transfer_recipient_pin`. This file is the SOURCE OF POLICY, not a hot-path decoder literal — the build-time guard (execution-venue.md §3.2) keeps these IDs OUT of any hot-path decoder/snipe file; they live here only.

HARD_RULES.no_stale_id_in_hot_path: These program IDs are DATA loaded here, never literals in a decoder or snipe-loop file (execution-venue.md §3.2 build-time guard). The signer reads them from this file; the hot core reads venue program IDs from the live-verified venue registry.
HARD_RULES.verify_at_build: Every entry below is marked VERIFY-AT-BUILD. The signer's boot probe (and CI) MUST confirm each `program_id` exists on-chain and is `executable=true` before it is admitted to the live allowlist. An entry that fails verification is dropped from the live set (fail-closed): an unverifiable ID is NOT allowlisted, so its instructions are REFUSED. IDs rotate (pump.fun's migration target already moved to PumpSwap, A-001) — a stale literal is the single most dangerous sniper bug.
HARD_RULES.fail_closed: Default-deny. Any program_id NOT explicitly present in the live (verified) set is refused. Adding a program is a config + deploy change, never a runtime POST.
HARD_RULES.tip_accounts_authoritative_source: The 8 Jito tip accounts below are REFERENCE values for review only. The signer fetches the authoritative set from `getTipAccounts` at boot (infrastructure.md §5.2 refusal #3) and pins THAT set. If the boot fetch disagrees with this file, the signer logs a mismatch alert and pins the boot-fetched set; it does NOT silently trust the file. This file's copy exists so a reviewer can diff it, and so the system can fail-closed (refuse value transfers) if getTipAccounts is unreachable at boot rather than widening the pin.

allowed_programs.name: system_program
allowed_programs.rationale: Required for the Jito tip transfer and ATA-rent funding. Its presence REQUIRES refusal #3 (value-moving-transfer pinning) below — System transfers are constrained by recipient, never allowed by omission.

allowed_programs.name: compute_budget_program
allowed_programs.rationale: Sets CU limit + CU price (priority fee) on every snipe/exit tx. Carries no ATTACKER-CONTROLLED exfiltration path (the priority fee is burned to the block-producing validator, never sent to an arbitrary recipient), BUT SetComputeUnitPrice x SetComputeUnitLimit IS real wallet SOL outflow -- it is NOT free. The signer's C3 pricing (aats/execution/signer_enforcer.py `_parse_and_price`) independently decodes both ComputeBudget instructions and folds the resulting priority-fee lamports into spend(tx) so it is bounded by the same per-tx (0.1 SOL) / rolling-aggregate (0.5 SOL) caps as any other spend. (Corrected fix round 1 MAJOR finding: the prior 'moves no value' text was FALSE for SetComputeUnitPrice and left this outflow unpriced.)

allowed_programs.name: spl_token_program
allowed_programs.rationale: SPL token transfers/approvals for the bought/sold token leg. NOTE: the on-chain hygiene runbook (custody-policy.md) forbids standing unlimited `Approve` delegations on the funding wallet; the signer SHOULD reject a Token `Approve`/`ApproveChecked` with an unbounded amount targeting an unknown delegate (see custody-policy.md on-chain hygiene).

allowed_programs.name: spl_token_2022_program
allowed_programs.rationale: Token-2022 mints exist among meme launches. Marked candidate: admit only if the venue path actually emits Token-2022 instructions, else keep it OUT of the live set (least privilege).

allowed_programs.name: associated_token_account_program
allowed_programs.rationale: Creates the wallet's ATA for the bought token. Rent destination must be the wallet's own derived ATA — see value_transfer_recipient_pin.own_ata_rent.

allowed_programs.name: pump_fun_bonding_curve
allowed_programs.rationale: pump.fun bonding-curve program — primary launch source. From the live-verified venue registry (execution-venue.md §3); duplicated here as the signer's independent allowlist copy.

allowed_programs.name: pumpswap_amm
allowed_programs.rationale: PumpSwap AMM — pump.fun's primary migration target (A-001). Migration sniper path. VERIFY-AT-BUILD is critical here: this is the ID that replaced the old Raydium migration target.

allowed_programs.name: raydium_amm_v4
allowed_programs.rationale: Raydium AMM v4 (constant-product). Direct-AMM snipe/exit + Jupiter-route leg + fallback exit path (A-011).

allowed_programs.name: raydium_cpmm
allowed_programs.rationale: Raydium CPMM (constant-product market maker, no OpenBook dependency). Newer migration/launch target.

allowed_programs.name: jupiter_aggregator_v6
allowed_programs.rationale: Jupiter v6 router — used for EXITS / survivors only (snipe buy is direct-AMM, FR-028). A Jupiter swap may internally route through allowed venue programs; the signer still independently checks every inner program_id against this list and every System transfer against the recipient pin, so a malicious route cannot exfiltrate via Jupiter.

allowed_programs.name: meteora_dlmm
allowed_programs.rationale: Meteora DLMM — enrichment/discovery CANDIDATE only (execution-venue.md §3.3). NOT in the live allowlist until verified AND a snipe/exit path actually targets it. Kept out of the hot path until promoted to active by config + deploy.

allowed_programs.name: moonshot
allowed_programs.rationale: Moonshot — enrichment/discovery CANDIDATE only. NOT in the live allowlist until verified and wired. Least privilege: candidate venues do not widen the signing surface.

live_set_policy.candidates_excluded_from_signing: Entries with status `candidate` (meteora, moonshot, token_2022 unless emitted) are present for discovery/enrichment but are NOT admitted to the signer's live allowlist until a deploy promotes them. The signer's live set = core programs + active venue programs + jupiter_v6 (verified at boot).

value_transfer_recipient_pin.rule: Every System-program SOL transfer (and any value-moving CPI that lands lamports) MUST have a recipient in this closed set. Any other recipient => REFUSE with reason `signer_unpinned_transfer`. This closes the SOL-exfiltration path that admitting the System program would otherwise reopen.

jito_tip_accounts.source_of_truth: getTipAccounts at boot (fetched live, pinned). The list below is a VERIFY-AT-BUILD reference copy for review and for fail-closed behaviour if getTipAccounts is unreachable.
jito_tip_accounts.NOTE: These reference values are the well-published Jito tip-account set. Because they rotate/expand only via Jito governance and the architecture pins the boot-fetched set, the signer treats getTipAccounts as authoritative and only uses this copy to (a) diff/alert on mismatch and (b) fail-closed if the live fetch fails. VERIFY-AT-BUILD: CI re-fetches getTipAccounts and asserts this copy still matches the live set; a mismatch fails the build so a stale pin is never shipped silently.

own_ata_rent.rule: ATA-creation rent transfers are allowed ONLY when the destination is an ATA deterministically derived from (WALLET_PUBKEY, mint, ATA program). The signer recomputes the ATA address from the wallet pubkey it holds and the tx's mint, and refuses any ATA-rent transfer to a non-derived address.

ci_steps: 1. Assert no base58 program-ID-shaped literal appears in any hot-path decoder/snipe file (execution-venue.md §3.2 guard) — this file is the only home for these IDs.
2. For each `active` + `core` + `router` entry: getAccountInfo(program_id) and assert account.executable == true on the configured cluster.
3. Re-fetch getTipAccounts and assert the 8 reference accounts equal the live set (fail the build on drift).
4. Assert the live allowlist count, the tip-account count (==8), and that the System program is present ONLY together with a non-empty value_transfer_recipient_pin.
